verses.1: The dead birds bring forth the scent of wisdom; they reveal something precious from the depths of intelligence. But it’s also a sign of foolishness.
verses.2: A wise heart is our strength, while a foolish heart leads us astray.
verses.3: And also, in the same way that a fool walks around with empty hands, and says to everyone, “He’s a fool.”
verses.4: If the Spirit of healing rises up from your place, do not be discouraged. For the one who heals will also forgive great sins.
verses.5: I saw a light under the sky, as if it were a mirage that came from before the sun.
verses.6: He gave knowledge in many ways; and those who are rich and powerful sat down in poverty.
verses.7: I saw servants riding on horses and camels, going about as if they were servants on the earth.
verses.8: The serpent digs holes in it; the scorpion and other reptiles also live there.
verses.9: He carries stones, which can be used to block paths; he cuts down trees, which can be used to harm others.
verses.10: If iron is heated, and it doesn’t turn into something else, then the flames will grow stronger, and the fire will spread further.
verses.11: If the snake moves without making any sound, then it’s impossible for the owner of the garden to catch it.
verses.12: The words of the wise man are gracious, but his lips are like those of a fool who will swallow us up.
verses.13: The beginning of his words is foolishness; later on, his words become evil and harmful.
verses.14: And the fool will say many things that people don’t know what will happen. And those who are around him will not be able to tell him what will happen.
verses.15: The labor of the foolish will weary us, since they don’t know how to get to the city.
verses.16: I will not go to a land where you ruled as a young man and maiden. In the morning, they will eat.
verses.17: You rule over a land that was once ruled by kings and rulers. But in those days, people ate with plenty, not starvation.
verses.18: In their weakness, the house will be destroyed; in their humility, the hands will be used to lift it up.
verses.19: Let us bake bread and wine; let life rejoice, and money answer all things.
verses.20: Also, in your knowledge, king, do not be cruel. In the chambers where you sleep, do not be cruel either. Do not be cruel to the rich, for the heavens will cover up their voices. And with wings, they will speak words.
